sources.title: On the Smallness of the Cosmological Constant in SUGRA Models Inspired by Degenerate Vacua

evidence.text: Can selected breakings of no-scale supergravity symmetries produce degenerate vacua with broken and unbroken supersymmetry, and can nonperturbative physics in the second vacuum explain a tiny positive cosmological constant through the multiple point principle?

sources.title: Minimal Stability in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: Across maximal gauged supergravities, what necessary conditions permit perturbative scalar stability when supersymmetry is broken, and can non-maximally-supersymmetric critical points approach the maximally supersymmetric vacuum continuously?

sources.title: De Sitter String Vacua from Dilaton-dependent Non-perturbative Effects

evidence.text: Can dilaton-dependent non-perturbative effects at singularities generate tunable de Sitter minima within LVS from a manifestly supersymmetric effective action, and extend large-volume stabilization to nonnegative Euler number?

sources.title: de Sitter vacua and supersymmetry breaking in six-dimensional flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can magnetic flux, anomaly cancellation and a gauge-invariant nonperturbative superpotential produce stabilized Minkowski or metastable de Sitter vacua in six-dimensional supergravity, and determine the associated supersymmetry-breaking mass spectrum?

sources.title: Phenomenological aspects of supergravity theories in de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can a minimal supergravity hidden sector support tunably small positive vacuum energy, satisfy quantum anomaly constraints, and generate distinguishable MSSM soft terms and spectra?

sources.title: The de Sitter swampland conjecture and supersymmetric AdS vacua

evidence.text: Does weak-coupling positivity create the same obstruction to supersymmetric heterotic dilaton stabilization that the note identifies in one-modulus IIB models?

sources.title: dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can two nonperturbative contributions stabilize the volume independently of the small supersymmetry-breaking scale needed for the final vacuum energy?

sources.title: de Sitter Minima from M theory and String theory

evidence.text: Can polynomial flux contributions replace some or all nonperturbative exponential terms while producing isolated supersymmetric Minkowski vacua, then locally stable de Sitter minima with all fourteen real scalars stabilized?

sources.title: Winding Uplifts and the Challenges of Weak and Strong SUSY Breaking in AdS

evidence.text: Can winding axion potentials produce parametrically small, long-lived F-term SUSY breaking, enabling AdS uplifts and testing conjectures against non-supersymmetric AdS and de Sitter vacua?

sources.title: Six and seven dimensional extrema of Non-SUSY heterotic theory with non-maximal enhancements

evidence.text: Can right-moving lattice symmetries systematically generate non-maximally enhanced extrema of the non-supersymmetric heterotic one-loop potential, and what do their Hessians imply for perturbative stability and refined de Sitter bounds?

sources.title: On the smallness of the cosmological constant in SUGRA models

evidence.text: Can selected symmetry breaking in no-scale supergravity produce degenerate vacua with broken and unbroken supersymmetry, and can the multiple point principle relate a tiny positive vacuum energy generated in a second phase to the cosmological constant in our phase?

sources.title: Constraints on meta-stable de Sitter flux vacua

evidence.text: Can geometry-independent stability constraints exclude metastable de Sitter flux critical points when supersymmetry breaking is dominated by the axion-dilaton, and what restrictions follow for nonsupersymmetric AdS vacua and vacuum statistics?

sources.title: On the Smallness of the Cosmological Constant in SUGRA Models Inspired by Degenerate Vacua

evidence.text: Estimate the second-vacuum strong scale using one-loop gauge-coupling running matched to the physical vacuum at the physical SUSY-breaking scale MS. The coefficients quoted are −7 for the SM and −3 for the MSSM; the proposed vacuum-energy estimate is Λ approximately ΛSQCD^4.

sources.title: Minimal Stability in Maximal Supergravity

evidence.text: The 70-dimensional mass matrix is contracted with physical sGoldstino directions. Quartic contractions are organized into 15 real and seven complex coordinates; quadratic gauging constraints and scalar equations yield linear relations among these quartic coordinates.

sources.title: De Sitter String Vacua from Dilaton-dependent Non-perturbative Effects

evidence.text: Minimize first with respect to the geometric small modulus and then the volume, imposing vacuum-energy tuning conditions. Analyze loop corrections and the loop-induced blow-up field redefinition separately, including stability conditions for candidate extrema.

sources.title: de Sitter vacua and supersymmetry breaking in six-dimensional flux compactifications

evidence.text: An inverse search fixes moduli expectation values and vacuum energy, then solves stationarity conditions for superpotential parameters, with one parameter fixed separately. Authors subsequently minimize the resulting potential and evaluate canonically normalized bosonic Hessians and fermion mass matrices.

sources.title: Phenomenological aspects of supergravity theories in de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Solve V=0 and ∂V=0 for parameter relations, then perturb the tuning to positive vacuum energy. Extract soft terms and use numerical renormalization-group evolution to obtain illustrative low-energy spectra.

sources.title: The de Sitter swampland conjecture and supersymmetric AdS vacua

evidence.text: Choose a positive tail value, then a farther point with a smaller value. Maximizing between the nonpositive interior endpoint and the farther tail point produces a positive stationary point. In a field theory, separately verify stationarity in all transverse directions.

sources.title: Soft supersymmetry breaking with tiny cosmological constant in flux compactified N=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: What restrictions on hidden-sector Kähler and superpotentials can jointly produce gravity-mediated TeV-scale soft supersymmetry breaking, stabilized hidden fields without flat directions, and a tiny positive total vacuum energy?

sources.title: de Sitter Conjectures in $N$=1 Supergravity

evidence.text: Which broken-supersymmetry N=1 supergravity potentials obey the conjectured quantum-gravity restrictions on positive potential energy, and can a rolling chiral field remove violations found in simple models?

sources.title: Perturbative Stability along the Supersymmetric Directions of the Landscape

evidence.text: When can a large supersymmetric spectator sector remain perturbatively stable after coupling to F-term supersymmetry breaking, at approximately Minkowski vacua or during slow-roll inflation, without a large mass hierarchy?

sources.title: On the Effective Description of Large Volume Compactifications

evidence.text: When does freezing the dilaton and complex-structure multiplets in two-step Large Volume Scenario stabilization remain a reliable approximately supersymmetric description after adding matter and gauge interactions, despite lacking a mass hierarchy?

sources.title: Axion Hilltops, Kahler Modulus Quintessence and the Swampland Criteria

evidence.text: Can a second nonperturbative term create a positive-energy local axion minimum while retaining modulus motion in the EFT of a supersymmetric vacuum?

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: An imaginary-field shift symmetry removes direct Kähler dependence on the rolling direction. The construction asks whether a small explicit superpotential breaking can create dark energy without restoring a gravitino-scale mass.

sources.title: Galois groups of uplifted de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Do univariate polynomials obtained from scalar-potential critical-point equations acquire nonsolvable Galois groups when selected perturbative type IIB vacua are uplifted from AdS or Minkowski to positive vacuum energy?

sources.title: A Note on 4D Heterotic String Vacua, FI-terms and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can the existence of black-hole decay channels impose F-flatness as well as D-flat cancellation of the anomalous FI term?

sources.title: Consequences of supergravity with gauged U(1)-R symmetry

evidence.text: What low-energy effects survive gauging U(1)R in supergravity when a hidden sector breaks R-symmetry at the Planck scale, breaks supersymmetry at an intermediate scale, and has vanishing vacuum D-term?

sources.title: Metastable spontaneous breaking of N=2 supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can rigid N=2 supersymmetry break spontaneously in metastable vacua without constant Fayet–Iliopoulos terms, using only one hypermultiplet and one Abelian vector multiplet? What scalar-mass bounds follow, and what can be inferred about an extension to de Sitter supergravity?

sources.title: A comment on effective field theories of flux vacua

evidence.text: When perturbative dynamics has runaway directions, can nonperturbative effects consistently be included to find low-energy vacua, particularly in supersymmetry-breaking no-scale supergravity and flux compactifications?

sources.title: de Sitter string vacua from Kahler uplifting

evidence.text: Can the leading perturbative α′ correction and a nonperturbative superpotential stabilize moduli in metastable de Sitter vacua at large volume and weak coupling, using spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking without an additional uplifting sector?

sources.title: Metastable SUSY Breaking and Supergravity at Finite Temperature

evidence.text: How does supergravity change the finite-temperature phase structure of metastable ISS supersymmetry breaking, and does cooling favor evolution toward the metastable vacuum?

sources.title: Building Supergravity Quintessence Model

evidence.text: This setting describes how a hidden source of supersymmetry breaking gravitationally affects a dark-energy scalar, even when the two superpotentials and the initial Kähler potential contain no direct cross terms.

sources.title: F‐theory and Dark Energy

evidence.text: Can F-theory on a curved Spin(7) background provide a dark energy sector with a supersymmetric ground state, cancelling quantum zero point energies while allowing split boson–fermion excitation spectra?

sources.title: Lectures on Supersymmetry Breaking

evidence.text: Review the conditions and mechanisms for spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, including metastability, and explain how nonperturbative gauge dynamics can produce semiclassically accessible breaking with a dynamically generated scale.

sources.title: On de Sitter vacua in strongly coupled heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative effects in heterotic M-theory produce four-dimensional de Sitter vacua with spontaneous F-term supersymmetry breaking while stabilizing the orbifold-length dilaton?

sources.title: Universal dS vacua in STU-models

evidence.text: Can polynomial superpotentials with generalized fluxes yield analytically controlled stable de Sitter critical points near supersymmetric or no-scale Minkowski points, and reproduce the local vacuum properties obtained using nonperturbative superpotentials?

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: How does MPP use an unbroken supersymmetric Minkowski phase to constrain the vacuum energy of a phase with hidden-sector supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: Can the symmetries responsible for no-scale vacuum-energy cancellation be broken enough to permit local supersymmetry breaking while retaining zero classical vacuum energy?

sources.title: De Sitter vacua from matter superpotentials

evidence.text: Can hidden-matter superpotential interactions generate local de Sitter or Minkowski vacua with spontaneous supersymmetry breaking, a hierarchically small breaking scale, and useful observable-sector soft terms?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Which supersymmetry-breaking contributions can cancel a small negative vacuum energy without overwhelming the non-perturbatively generated gravitino scale? The source explores existing uplift proposals and their compatibility with flux-stabilized sectors.

sources.title: Kähler-Dirac fermions on Euclidean dynamical triangulations

evidence.text: Can Kähler-Dirac valence fermions on fluctuating four-dimensional EDT geometries recover the expected continuum spectrum, and does strongly coupled gravity induce spontaneous breaking of their chiral-related U(1) symmetry at order the Planck scale?

sources.title: Kähler-Dirac fermions on Euclidean dynamical triangulations

evidence.text: Construct oriented incidence matrices using a spanning tree of the dual lattice and unique simplex identification labels for degeneracies. Boundary/coboundary matrices satisfy d²=δ²=0; these identities are checked on individual geometries.

sources.title: Kähler-Dirac fermions on Euclidean dynamical triangulations

evidence.text: Extract the smallest 350 unique eigenvalues from the Hermitian squared operator, then fit their volume dependence with eigenvalue-specific power laws using nonlinear least squares and jackknife errors. Bilinear traces use stochastic Z_2 noise and an a/N_4+b infinite-volume extrapolation.

sources.title: Kähler-Dirac fermions on Euclidean dynamical triangulations

evidence.text: Pion-like connected meson correlators use products of fermion propagators. Sources and sinks are smeared over four-simplices, with distance measured by dual edges. Masses come from intermediate-distance fits to A exp(−mr), or A exp(−mr)/r^b on finer ensembles.

sources.title: Constraints on global symmetry breaking in quantum gravity from cosmic birefringence measurements

evidence.text: Conditional on explaining cosmic birefringence with a very light pseudoscalar, can its required small mass place an observational upper limit on explicit global-symmetry breaking by gravity, and thereby constrain nonperturbative quantum-gravity effects?

sources.title: Lorentz invariance violations in the interplay of quantum gravity with matter

evidence.text: Does Lorentz violation in preferred-frame quantum gravity radiatively enter an Abelian matter sector, persist toward low energies, and permit indirect constraints on gravitational symmetry breaking?

sources.title: Asymptotically safe quantum gravity and its phenomenology -- a review

evidence.text: Can quantum scale symmetry make metric quantum gravity predictive and keep physical observables well behaved at high energies? This review surveys fixed-point evidence, extensions toward realistic matter and Lorentzian signature, and possible phenomenological consequences.

sources.title: Light charged fermions in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can gravity support an interacting Abelian ultraviolet fixed point without making charged fermions critical, and does compatibility with light fermions impose a lower bound on their number?

sources.title: Light fermions in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can quantum metric fluctuations induce chiral symmetry breaking and Planck-scale fermion masses, and what restrictions does the existence of light fermions place on asymptotically safe or effective quantum gravity?

sources.title: Fermions and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does quantum gravity require an infinite tower coupled to every fermion, with its scale determined by Yukawa interactions, and does this requirement restrict supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Quantum gravity and Standard-Model-like fermions

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity fluctuations make explicit fermion-mass breaking irrelevant, allowing chiral symmetry and light Standard-Model-like fermions to emerge toward the infrared?

sources.title: Indications against Dynamical <math display="inline"><mrow><mi>C</mi><mi>P</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow></math> Symmetry Restoration in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can gravitational RG effects suppress ultraviolet CPT violation sufficiently to produce an approximately CPT-symmetric low-energy theory, or must CPT be imposed fundamentally, apart from extreme tuning?

sources.title: Fermion Doubling in Loop Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Do low-energy chiral fermionic excitations in Hamiltonian loop quantum gravity exhibit fermion doubling when expanded around a regular-lattice gravitational background, and under which assumptions can the lattice Nielsen–Ninomiya theorem be applied?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Implications of Quantum Gravity for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Review how quantum-gravity consistency conditions constrain low-energy EFT and might inform strong CP, the weak scale, new gauge interactions and dark energy. The white paper explicitly does not guarantee that gravitational considerations solve these problems.

sources.title: No fermion doubling in quantum geometry

evidence.text: Can quantum superpositions of spin-network geometries with different vertex spacings prevent the fermion doubling associated with discretized matter equations, thereby opening a route to chiral fermions in loop quantum gravity?

sources.title: Why the quark mass is not the Planck mass

evidence.text: Can fermions carrying both Abelian and non-Abelian charge remain much lighter than the Planck mass when coupled to quantum gravity, or do gravity and gauge fluctuations drive four-fermion interactions to chiral-symmetry-breaking criticality?

sources.title: Supergravity based inflation models: a review

evidence.text: How can supergravity inflation evade Hubble-scale inflaton masses and the exponential obstruction to large fields? The review presents representative models and extends the discussion to nonminimal Higgs inflation.

evidence.text: Which no-scale supergravity models reproduce the Starobinsky inflationary potential, how can their spectator fields be stabilized, and which generalizations change the CMB predictions?

sources.title: Electroweak relaxation of cosmological hierarchy

evidence.text: Can an R-squared scalaron, coupled nonminimally to the Higgs and supplemented by negative bare vacuum energy, connect primordial inflation to a residual electroweak-generated dark-energy scale?

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: The model identifies the Standard Model Higgs with the inflaton by coupling its radial field nonminimally to curvature. The analysis asks whether the resulting Einstein-frame potential obeys the refined de Sitter inequalities.

sources.title: Non-minimal Higgs inflation in the context of warm scenario in the light of Planck data

evidence.text: Can non-minimal Higgs inflation, treated as warm inflation with dissipation Γ=Γ0T, produce scalar tilt, tensor fraction and running compatible with the Planck constraints used in the paper?

sources.title: Refined swampland conjecture in deformed Starobinsky gravity

evidence.text: Can a small change in the power of the curvature-squared term alter Starobinsky inflation enough to reconcile its observable predictions with potential-based quantum-gravity conjectures?

evidence.text: Use curvature corrections to describe inflation and assess whether their parameters can accommodate cosmological information and the paper's proposed quantum-gravity restrictions.

sources.title: On hybrid monodromy inflation — hic sunt dracones

evidence.text: Can Stewart-type two-field hybrid inflation fit CMB constraints with sub-Planckian excursions while remaining stable against field-theory and quantum-gravity corrections, and can a massive-form realization supply the required protection?

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: The model asks whether a nonminimally coupled Higgs can drive inflation while an exponentially coupled second scalar remains available for late dark energy.

sources.title: Two-Field quintessential Higgs Inflation

evidence.text: Can a Higgs inflaton coexist with exponentially coupled quintessence while meeting CMB constraints, electroweak-vacuum stability requirements, and a proposed order-one potential-gradient bound?

sources.title: S-dual inflation and the string swampland

evidence.text: Can reflection-symmetric single-field inflation satisfy CMB constraints and proposed quantum-gravity restrictions simultaneously? Does replacing potential endpoints with exact dynamical endpoints materially change that assessment?

sources.title: Palatini Higgs inflation and the refined dS conjecture

evidence.text: The setting isolates how an independently varied gravitational connection changes the canonical Higgs inflation potential and its refined-dS diagnostics. The analysis keeps a single scalar and freezes the non-minimal coupling xi.

sources.title: Implications of Palatini gravity for inflation and beyond

evidence.text: How does treating the metric and connection independently change inflationary predictions, reheating, and models connecting inflation to late-time acceleration when non-minimal couplings or higher-curvature terms are present?

sources.title: Starobinsky inflation in the swampland

evidence.text: Is Starobinsky inflation generated by an R² correction compatible with quantum gravity, when that correction originates from quantum effects of a light-species tower?

sources.title: Starobinsky inflation beyond the leading order

evidence.text: How do perturbative Grisaru–Zanon quartic-curvature corrections affect Starobinsky inflation, what bounds follow from effective gravitational consistency conditions, and can the induced CMB shifts compete with classical corrections beyond leading order in inverse e-fold number?

sources.title: Higgs-modular inflation

evidence.text: How does a Higgs field carrying modular weight alter modular-inflation trajectories, observables, cutoff estimates, and reheating when it also couples nonminimally to gravity?

sources.title: Deformations of Starobinsky inflation in no-scale SU(5) and SO(10) GUTs

evidence.text: Can GUT-induced deformations of no-scale Starobinsky inflation accommodate the CMB scalar tilts discussed in the paper while respecting proton longevity, dark-matter abundance, Higgs-mass and reheating constraints, and reducing sensitivity to large initial inflaton values?

sources.title: Genesis-Starobinsky inflation can explain the ACT data

evidence.text: Can a nonsingular Horndeski Genesis phase transition stably into Starobinsky inflation, and can its residual corrections raise the scalar spectral index enough to improve agreement with the CMB constraints quoted in the paper?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures through ACT observations: Observational signatures of radiative-corrected inflation

evidence.text: Can radiatively corrected inflation simultaneously satisfy the paper's ACT/Planck/BAO observational benchmarks and the FRDSSC, SWGC, and SSWGC? The comparison concerns non-minimal Higgs inflation and a scalar-inflaton model with additional scalar and fermion sectors.

sources.title: Induced Multi-phase Inflation with Reheating: Leptogenesis and Dark Matter Production in Metric versus Palatini

evidence.text: How do metric and Palatini gravity change the connection between non-minimal scalar inflation, radiatively stable reheating, decay-produced fermionic dark matter and Type-I-seesaw non-thermal leptogenesis?

sources.title: Warm inflation in Weyl geometric gravity

evidence.text: Can matter-coupled Weyl R̃² gravity support dissipative inflation with a natural transition to radiation domination, and produce scalar/tensor observables compatible with the observational bounds adopted by the authors?

sources.title: Evading the Swampland de Sitter Obstruction via Thermodynamic Duality-Induced Horizon Corrections in Unimodular Gravity

evidence.text: Can quantum corrections to apparent-horizon entropy produce inflationary attractors in unimodular gravity with power-law nonlinear electrodynamics, while satisfying de Sitter and Distance conjectures and providing sufficient inflation?

sources.title: Non-minimal unimodular inflation revisited: Swampland diagnostics and CMB constraints

evidence.text: Can minimal non-minimal unimodular inflation simultaneously reproduce CMB observables, support a controlled 50–60 e-fold history with a standard exit, and satisfy FRDSSC, SWGC and SSWGC?

sources.title: Supergravity based inflation models: a review

evidence.text: One-loop potentials from supersymmetry-breaking mass splittings generate hybrid-inflation slopes. Running-mass models use scale-dependent masses to flatten a region even when the tree-level inflaton mass is large.

sources.title: Starobinsky-like Inflationary Models as Avatars of No-Scale Supergravity

evidence.text: Explicit superpotential constructions include W=M[φ²/2−φ³/(3√3)] with T fixed at 1/2, and W=√3 Mφ(T−1/2) with the matter field fixed at zero. Interchanges and sign changes in the symmetric coordinates generate further examples.

sources.title: Electroweak relaxation of cosmological hierarchy

evidence.text: Treat desired local energy and curvature as inverse constraints on potential parameters. Solve the coupled equations, impose conformal and sign conditions, and check small-ε residuals. A separate first-derivative and dynamical test is required before interpreting the solution as frozen quintessence.

sources.title: Higgs Inflation and the Refined dS Conjecture

evidence.text: Find the field subsets satisfying each branch, compare their endpoints, and convert overlap and endpoint conditions into parameter inequalities. The paper applies this operation to the Higgs potential's decreasing slope ratio and nonmonotonic curvature ratio.

sources.title: Non-minimal Higgs inflation in the context of warm scenario in the light of Planck data

evidence.text: Use conformal transformation and a scalar-field redefinition to work with the Einstein-frame Higgs potential, then apply warm-inflation slow-roll background equations rather than solve the full coupled evolution.

sources.title: Refined swampland conjecture in deformed Starobinsky gravity

evidence.text: Treat derivative diagnostics as local inputs, solve the coefficient inequality, and enforce positivity and normalization of a,b. Uniform application additionally requires intersecting the allowed intervals over the field domain.

sources.title: How accidental was inflation?

evidence.text: How sensitively do supergravity inflation models depend on relative couplings, and can small departures from their Starobinsky or new-inflation limits improve CMB agreement while alleviating large-field initial-condition problems? The focus is potential-flatness tuning rather than the overall inflationary hierarchy.

sources.title: Gauss–Bonnet Inflation and the String Swampland

evidence.text: Do the adopted quantum-gravity conjectures point toward a particular curvature coupling in inflation?

sources.title: Inflection-point inflation and dark matter redux

evidence.text: Can two phenomenological small-field, near-inflection-point inflation potentials satisfy the paper's CMB constraints and produce all cold dark matter through perturbative inflaton decay, while respecting radiative stability, reheating, BBN and Lyman-α restrictions?

sources.title: Modular Inflation at Higher Level $N$

evidence.text: Do modular-inflation quotient geometries satisfy the volume, distance, and topology criteria the authors associate with a possible quantum-gravity completion?

sources.title: Non-minimally coupled Natural Inflation: Palatini and Metric formalism with the recent BICEP/Keck

evidence.text: How does a polynomial nonminimal inflaton–curvature coupling change natural-inflation predictions for ns, r and α in Metric and Palatini formulations, and which sampled parameters agree with the BICEP/Keck contours used in this 2022 paper under specified reheating histories?

sources.title: Non-Minimal M-flation

evidence.text: Can nonminimal coupling to gravity improve matrix inflation's observational predictions, reduce the required D3-brane multiplicity, enable spectator preheating and alleviate excursions beyond the proposed UV cutoff?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation on the brane

evidence.text: How does the minimal high-energy modification of gravity on a stable three-brane change slow-roll inflation and primordial perturbations, and can quadratic chaotic inflation occur below the four-dimensional Planck scale?

sources.title: Cosmic inflation from broken conformal symmetry

evidence.text: Can an asymptotically flat inflationary potential emerge from Palatini quadratic gravity by appropriately breaking local conformal symmetry in matter kinetic and effective potential terms, without imposing an additional global symmetry?

sources.title: Primordial black holes in non-minimal Gauss–Bonnet inflation in light of the PTA data

evidence.text: Can a two-part inflaton–Gauss–Bonnet coupling make monomial inflation compatible with CMB constraints while enhancing small-scale curvature perturbations enough for PBHs and scalar-induced gravitational waves, including a possible PTA signal?

sources.title: Inflationary dynamics of non-minimally coupled f(R) matter-curvature theories

evidence.text: Can power-law nonminimal matter-curvature couplings support stable inflation, how do their full background dynamics change CMB predictions, and can they resolve the graceful-exit problem of old inflation?

sources.title: Probable or Improbable Universe? Correlating Electroweak Vacuum Instability with the Scale of Inflation

evidence.text: How does inflation populate the unstable high-field Higgs region, and what constraints on inflation or stabilizing physics follow once alternative post-inflation fates of these regions are considered?

sources.title: Swampland conjectures in hybrid metric-Palatini gravity

evidence.text: The hybrid action retains metric curvature R while adding f(𝓡), where 𝓡 is built from an independent connection. The construction supplies the modified gravitational dynamics used for the inflationary application.

sources.title: Chaplygin inflation

evidence.text: Can a phenomenological modification of gravity inspired by the Chaplygin density law accommodate chaotic inflation, and which Chaplygin and inflaton scales satisfy the paper's CMB constraints? The authors aim to identify required assumptions and extrapolations rather than establish superiority over conventional inflation.

sources.title: Quintessence Saves Higgs Instability

evidence.text: Does a complete inflationary theory satisfy the conjectural gradient condition and evolve into the quintessence–Higgs setting with the required early scalar value? The paper identifies this consistency and matching problem but does not solve it.

sources.title: Further Refining Swampland Conjecture on Inflation in General Scalar-Tensor Theories of Gravity

evidence.text: How does a phenomenological power-law correction modify nonminimally coupled quartic inflation and its potential-derivative constraints?

sources.title: Two scalar fields inflation from scale-invariant gravity with modified measure

evidence.text: Can globally scale-invariant gravity with an independent integration measure naturally generate two scalar degrees of freedom, inflation and a small positive final vacuum energy in the second-order formalism?

sources.title: The Standard Model Higgs boson as the inflaton

evidence.text: Can the Standard Model Higgs drive inflation and generate acceptable primordial perturbations through a non-minimal gravitational coupling, without introducing an additional inflaton particle?

membershipSample.placementReason: Explicitly includes both supergravity potential construction and nonminimal Higgs gravitational structure.
membershipSample.placementQualification: q85 covers both the supergravity obstruction-avoidance review and its nonminimal Higgs extension. q12 and q66 cover the potential-flatness core, but the packet does not establish that their scalar-potential settings encompass the extension's nonminimal gravitational structure. q85 explicitly includes both. The canonical-Kähler premise qualifies the stated obstruction and is not imposed on every remedy.

destinations.title: How can supergravity inflation evade Hubble-scale inflaton masses and the exponential obstruction to large fields? The review presents representative models and extends the discussion to nonminimal Higgs inflation.
Which no-scale supergravity models reproduce the Starobinsky inflationary potential, how can their spectator fields be stabilized, and which generalizations change the CMB predictions?
Can an R-squared scalaron, coupled nonminimally to the Higgs and supplemented by negative bare vacuum energy, connect primordial inflation to a residual electroweak-generated dark-energy scale?

The model identifies the Standard Model Higgs with the inflaton by coupling its radial field nonminimally to curvature. The analysis asks whether the resulting Einstein-frame potential obeys the refined de Sitter inequalities.
Can non-minimal Higgs inflation, treated as warm inflation with dissipation Γ=Γ0T, produce scalar tilt, tensor fraction and running compatible with the Planck constraints used in the paper?
Can a small change in the power of the curvature-squared term alter Starobinsky inflation enough to reconcile its observable predictions with potential-based quantum-gravity conjectures?
Use curvature corrections to describe inflation and assess whether their parameters can accommodate cosmological information and the paper's proposed quantum-gravity restrictions.

Can Stewart-type two-field hybrid inflation fit CMB constraints with sub-Planckian excursions while remaining stable against field-theory and quantum-gravity corrections, and can a massive-form realization supply the required protection?
The model asks whether a nonminimally coupled Higgs can drive inflation while an exponentially coupled second scalar remains available for late dark energy.
Can a Higgs inflaton coexist with exponentially coupled quintessence while meeting CMB constraints, electroweak-vacuum stability requirements, and a proposed order-one potential-gradient bound?

Can reflection-symmetric single-field inflation satisfy CMB constraints and proposed quantum-gravity restrictions simultaneously? Does replacing potential endpoints with exact dynamical endpoints materially change that assessment?

The setting isolates how an independently varied gravitational connection changes the canonical Higgs inflation potential and its refined-dS diagnostics. The analysis keeps a single scalar and freezes the non-minimal coupling xi.

How does treating the metric and connection independently change inflationary predictions, reheating, and models connecting inflation to late-time acceleration when non-minimal couplings or higher-curvature terms are present?
Is Starobinsky inflation generated by an R² correction compatible with quantum gravity, when that correction originates from quantum effects of a light-species tower?

How do perturbative Grisaru–Zanon quartic-curvature corrections affect Starobinsky inflation, what bounds follow from effective gravitational consistency conditions, and can the induced CMB shifts compete with classical corrections beyond leading order in inverse e-fold number?
How does a Higgs field carrying modular weight alter modular-inflation trajectories, observables, cutoff estimates, and reheating when it also couples nonminimally to gravity?

Can GUT-induced deformations of no-scale Starobinsky inflation accommodate the CMB scalar tilts discussed in the paper while respecting proton longevity, dark-matter abundance, Higgs-mass and reheating constraints, and reducing sensitivity to large initial inflaton values?

Can a nonsingular Horndeski Genesis phase transition stably into Starobinsky inflation, and can its residual corrections raise the scalar spectral index enough to improve agreement with the CMB constraints quoted in the paper?

Can radiatively corrected inflation simultaneously satisfy the paper's ACT/Planck/BAO observational benchmarks and the FRDSSC, SWGC, and SSWGC? The comparison concerns non-minimal Higgs inflation and a scalar-inflaton model with additional scalar and fermion sectors.

How do metric and Palatini gravity change the connection between non-minimal scalar inflation, radiatively stable reheating, decay-produced fermionic dark matter and Type-I-seesaw non-thermal leptogenesis?

Can matter-coupled Weyl R̃² gravity support dissipative inflation with a natural transition to radiation domination, and produce scalar/tensor observables compatible with the observational bounds adopted by the authors?

Can quantum corrections to apparent-horizon entropy produce inflationary attractors in unimodular gravity with power-law nonlinear electrodynamics, while satisfying de Sitter and Distance conjectures and providing sufficient inflation?
Can minimal non-minimal unimodular inflation simultaneously reproduce CMB observables, support a controlled 50–60 e-fold history with a standard exit, and satisfy FRDSSC, SWGC and SSWGC?
